protocol.phase_definition: environment_step / env._max_episode_steps; early < 1/3, middle < 2/3, late otherwise
protocol.phase_decision_timing: phase horizon applies when a group commitment expires and its next chunk is queried
protocol.phase_transition: no forced query at phase boundary; existing commitment continues

metrics.success_rate: macro mean of per-task success rates; pooled rate also reported
metrics.environment_steps: sum and macro mean over runtime rollouts
metrics.policy_queries: sum and macro mean of frozen ACT full-chunk calls
metrics.confidence_intervals: task-level bootstrap 95% CI, 20,000 draws, seed 20260819; per-task Wilson intervals
